args: $maxRetries = 4; $attempt = 0; while ($attempt -lt $maxRetries) { $attempt++; Write-Host "=== Attempt $attempt of $maxRetries ==="; & .venv\Scripts\pybricksdev.exe run ble --name GambareYalla Spike/main.py; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } elseif ($attempt -lt $maxRetries) { Write-Host "Connection failed, retrying in 2 seconds..."; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } }; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: stop
args:
$stopScript = @'
import sys
import asyncio
from pybricksdev.connections import PybricksBLE

async def stop_program():
    try:
        hub = await PybricksBLE.find_device()
        print(f"Stopping program on {hub.device_info.name}...")
        await hub.stop()
        print("Program stopped.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Could not stop program: {e}")
        print("Try pressing the hub's button to stop the program.")

asyncio.run(stop_program())
'@; $stopScript | & .venv\Scripts\python.exe -
